==Biography==
===2017 Season===
'''Aodi''' started as a player on the [[EDward Gaming]] training squad [[EDG.Revengers]], which qualified for the LSPL and renamed to [[Team Hurricane]]. Instead of playing in the LSPL, Aodi was added to the EDG starting roster to split playtime with [[Mouse]]. He also changed his name to '''Audi'''. During the [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Season|2017 LPL Summer Season]], Audi played only a handful of games, and most of them were losses, including two losses at [[Rift Rivals 2017/LCK-LPL-LMS|Rift Rivals]] to LMS teams. By the time the split was halfway over, Audi was barely seeing any playtime, and did not compete during playoffs or [[2017_Season_World_Championship/Main_Event|2017 Worlds]]. At the end of the season, he left the team, changed his name to '''Freecss''', and joined [[Bilibili Gaming]], the new organization of [[I May]].

== Trivia ==
* His former ID '''Freecss''' is named after the character Gon Freecss from the manga [[wikipedia:en:Hunter_%C3%97_Hunter|''Hunter x Hunter'']].
* His ID '''Aodi''' was his given name (Ao-Di). He once changed this ID to '''Audi''' due to its similarity to the [[wikipedia:en:Audi|German automobile manufacturer]].
* After his poor performance in [[Rift Rivals 2017]], fans went to the official weibo of Audi (the German automobile manufacturer) and left comments that flamed the player.
